blend1-story: Tenshi Game house style: bold, chunky, cute anime game art with a smooth, juicy, polished finish. Characters about 4 heads tall with rounded chunky shapes, big sparkly glossy anime eyes and expressive happy faces. Medium hand-inked outlines in dark plum and local colour (heavier on the outer silhouette, lighter inside), never pure black. Bold cel shading with clean flat fills and one crisp shadow tone, finished with smooth gradient light, crisp glossy specular highlights and a soft rim light. Strongest gel, jelly, liquid-glass and thin holographic-film shine only on eyes, halos, water, magic effects and the most important objects; hair and gold get a soft sheen; skin, cloth and plain stone stay matte and clean. No paper, pencil or brush texture. Pastel prism rainbow palette (bubblegum pink #FF8FC0, peach #FFB27A, lemon #FFE27A, mint #9BEFC9, baby blue #9CDEFF, lilac #C9B4FF) with saturated jelly accents (#FF4FA0, #FF8A2B, #3DB8FF, #9E6BFF). Bright, readable, low clutter, child-friendly. Original characters, no franchise likeness. No text, letters, logos or watermark. BLEND DIAL: mostly bold cel (C-leaning). Flat fills and crisp hard-edged shadows dominate, outlines on the bolder side of medium, sticker-like clean shapes. Gloss is a small accent: sharp white specular dots on eyes, halos, the mermaid tail, water and the key object only. Hair, clothes and buildings stay almost flat. The heroes are two angel kids, one girl and one boy: the girl angel has long lavender-pink hair and a white-and-gold dress; the boy angel has short sky-blue hair and a white-and-gold tunic; both have small white wings and glowing gel-ring halos. The Mermaid has aqua hair and a glittering pearly tail. SCENE: a visual-novel story illustration (cutscene CG), wide 3:2. In a sunny Ancient Roman courtyard, the girl angel and the boy angel lean over the rim of a round marble fountain, delighted, as the Mermaid splashes up out of the sparkling water to meet them. Columns, a red banner and terracotta roofs behind. Keep the lower fifth of the image calm and simple so a dialogue box could sit there later.
